summary: On-demand contextual audit feed: session reassembly + SIEM field-mapping with per-batch signed manifest
description:
Issue summary: HelixBank has requested an on-demand export that rebuilds full user sessions across multiple API calls (session reassembly) and maps Redwood audit fields into their custom SIEM schema (fields: hb_user_id, hb_session_id, hb_request_latency_ms, hb_model_variant). They require per-batch signed manifests (ED25519) and UTC-normalized timestamps with event timezone preserved as an additional field.

Impact: Customer cannot complete SOC2 evidence review until they receive a demonstrable export format that preserves session context, supports reversible pseudonymization, and includes a signed manifest for chain-of-custody. This is blocking their quarterly audit package submission.

Request: Provide a one-time on-demand export for a 72-hour window (2026-03-05T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-07T23:59:59Z) with the following requirements: 1) NDJSON compressed (gz) with one event per line, 2) session reassembly where events are grouped by hb_session_id and annotated with session_start and session_end in UTC, 3) reversible pseudonymization of hb_user_id using HSM-backed tokenization (customer-supplied public key for wrap), 4) per-batch manifest signed using Redwood's export signing key (ED25519) containing batch_uuid, start_ts, end_ts, record_count, sha256 of payload, 5) timezone normalization to UTC plus original_timezone field, 6) SIEM field mapping CSV and an example ingestion script for HelixBank's Splunk HEC endpoint.

Acceptance criteria: Customer can ingest the provided NDJSON into their SIEM with field mappings applied, verify the manifest signature, and replay session sequences for three sampled session_ids supplied by customer.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer provided sample session_ids: SESS-000125, SESS-000998, SESS-000777.
2) Expected export semantics: events ordered by event_ts then by seq_in_session.
3) To validate locally: gunzip export.gz | head -n 200 | jq -c '. | {hb_session_id, event_ts, seq_in_session, hb_user_id_masked, original_timezone}'

Full 72-hour export scheduled for 2026-03-12 02:15 UTC (maintenance window).
